evals.prompt: Check my Cloudflare domains. side.com and notes.com point email at ImprovMX and have no DMARC record. shop.com has a DMARC record.
evals.expected_output: Says side.com and notes.com are missing DMARC and that is a delivery issue. Says shop.com has DMARC. Does not add a record.
assertions: Says side.com and notes.com are missing DMARC
Says that is a delivery issue

evals.prompt: parked.com is on Cloudflare. It has no email settings and no DMARC. Do I have a delivery problem?
evals.expected_output: Says there is no mail setup, so this is not a delivery issue yet. Does not add DMARC.
assertions: Says there is no mail setup
Says this is not a delivery issue yet

evals.prompt: other.com uses a different DNS host, not Cloudflare. Is DMARC missing?
evals.expected_output: Says the domain is not on Cloudflare DNS, so this check cannot see it. Does not invent a record.
assertions: Says the domain is not on Cloudflare DNS

evals.prompt: I bought a side domain. Should I use ImprovMX so hello@side.com lands in Gmail?
evals.expected_output: Uses the improvmx skill. Does not run the DMARC scan as the decision.
assertions: Does not run the DMARC scan as the decision
